name: TC Energy Build Strong (Environment)
summary: Corporate community giving; its environment focus funds land, water and species conservation projects by non-profits and others near TC Energy operations in Canada and the US.

geography.label: Within about 30 km of TC Energy operations in Canada and the US

reporting: Successful applicants complete an impact reporting survey within a year of the award.

eligibility.rule: Be in a community within approximately 30 kilometres of TC Energy operations or projects
Not be an individual, GoFundMe or similar campaign
Not be an advocacy or lobby initiative
Not request operating expenses, dues or memberships
Apply no more than once per calendar year

documents: Detailed budget breakdown for funding requested from TC Energy

geography.quote: We consider investment opportunities from communities within an approximate 30-kilometre (20-mile) radius of our operations or projects

access.quote: Apply for funding Make a positive impact in your community

window.quote: We will accept applications on a rolling basis from February 23, 2026 - November 9, 2026.

reporting.quote: If you are a successful applicant, you will be required to provide impact data metrics via a reporting survey that TC Energy will send you within one year of being awarded your funds.

eligibility.quote: We consider investment opportunities from communities within an approximate 30-kilometre (20-mile) radius of our operations or projects, that:

Operating expenses, dues or memberships (includes staff wages, utilities, honorariums, rent, etc.).
Organizations can apply for funding once per calendar year.

after_award.quote: If you are a successful applicant, you will be required to provide impact data metrics via a reporting survey that TC Energy will send you within one year of being awarded your funds.
